actual_scope.source_split_evidence_scope: Accepted full train/dev manifest identity and source isolation records; selected compression NPZ bytes/pixels were checked. Original source video was not live-rehashed.

what_was_verified: The preaccepted ordinary TRAIN row and frozen legacy Rphi cache identity were preserved; Rphi was not rerun.
Z_raw was encoded from the actual observed RGB after official same-size PIL uint8 preprocessing. It remains the raw warm-start latent for future comparisons.
Z_R was encoded from clipped Rphi RGB after the same P preprocessing. The decoder consumed the exact saved Z_R and its exact FP16 stage cast.
The two latent file and array SHA values were independently recomputed locally. The remote CPU auditor additionally checked the actual 105431168-byte VAE_R NPY.

Frozen inventories cover 559 parameters and 42 registered buffers. Initial/final JSON files are byte-identical, with matching canonical tensor fingerprints, producer-recorded version/object/freeze checks, and restored wrappers/math.
Only VAE/context asset bytes were independently rehashed remotely; the complete parent manifest and original metadata fingerprint remain fixed.

latent_relationships.VAE_R_semantics: as returned by H3 decode, after VAE internal clamp; no pre-clamp claim

asset_scope.scope_evidence: used bytes independently rehashed; producer non-use follows frozen source and recorded loader boundaries, not syscall tracing

timing_and_memory.producer_timer_scope: Begins after CPU input inspection; includes VAE loading, two encodes, one decode, hashing and evidence work. Not end-to-end restoration or steady-state FPS.

scientific_limits: This is cache engineering acceptance, with no PSNR, LPIPS, temporal fidelity, no-harm or downstream task-quality gate.
No H3 sampling, denoising step, backward pass, optimizer step or training was performed. The result is not full 32-source training progress.
One existing training source and one ordinary compression sample provide no held-out or cross-source generalization evidence, and do not establish an omni restoration method.
VAE_R is the as-returned output after the VAE internal clamp. No true pre-internal-clamp pixels were captured, so saturation effects cannot be inferred from this cache alone.
Z_raw and Z_R differ, but that difference alone is not evidence of repair benefit. Official uint8 preprocessing changes Rphi values and must remain part of any paired downstream protocol.
Parent recipe fingerprint is metadata provenance. Unused base/refiner/turbo files were not resolved, stat-ed, hashed or loaded; no full-recipe readiness or merge safety is established.
No cross-host numerical parity or comparison with a previous independently generated copy of this TRAIN cache was tested.
Model tensor byte/version observations are producer-recorded and bound to frozen source; the local audit does not reread a live NPU model.
recommended_next_step: Reuse these immutable, hash-bound caches only in a separately admitted limited TRAIN experiment. Preserve Z_raw warm-start and the original clipped R anchor. A full H3 experiment still requires actual verification of its base/refiner/turbo assets and its own execution/quality gates; do not expand data or claim quality from this cache pass.
